newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly lower, top shares flat.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly lower, top shares flat.

text.p: Most Croatian stocks edged down on Tuesday in modest trade, with top shares drugs firm Pliva and Zagrebacka Banka holding ground.
* Ten of 14 active issues fell, one rose and three were flat.
* Volume slightly higher at 7,524 shares, turnover also rose to 7.6 million kuna.
* The only gainer hotelier Riviera Porec added eight kuna to 160, selling 1,134 units.
* Top loser electric manufacturer Koncar fell 200 kuna to 1,000, with 106 shares sold.
* Most active Zagrebacka Banka traded flat at 2,000 kuna on volume of 2,809 shares.
